Innovation, creative problem-solving and positive change happen when people step out of their comfort zone and think differently. Our values, workplace practices, wellness programs, benefits and compensation are aimed at helping employees manage their unique personal life and care for their families so they can focus on contributing to the fullest. 
 Position Overview : 
 Devon’s Geosciences Internship provides students with the opportunity to learn and apply geoscience principles in a professional environment. Students participate in both team and individual assignments, gaining exposure to real-world tasks and projects , as well as apply the latest principles of geology and geophysics to the exploration and exploitation of hydrocarbons in North America. This program is designed to help students develop technical and professional skills while exploring potential career opportunities at Devon. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Perform duties typically assigned to an entry-level geosciences petro -technical professional within Devon’s Business Units. 
 Assist geologists and geophysicists in evaluating prospective oil and gas trends, identifying new drilling prospects, and supporting projects within existing fields.
